authority_rule: A verifier derives deltas by diffing child and parent. Signers and thresholds are evaluated against the parent. An unlisted delta is rejected. A child is also rejected if any permanently revoked DeviceID re-enters messaging/control eligibility.
parent_majority: floor(N/2)+1 where N is the number of parent active_control_devices; quarantined controllers remain in N
recovery_vote: one constitutional vote only where the transition row permits it; it never counts for ordinary quarantine lift, safety-freeze resolution or fork bridge

transitions.target_constraint: target DeviceID is not present in the parent or child permanently_revoked_devices; a returning device uses a fresh DeviceID
target DeviceID is not present in the parent or child permanently_revoked_devices; a returning device uses a fresh DeviceID

candidate profile defines security_generation.one_to_one and that value is strictly greater than the parent minimum profile one_to_one generation; profile id and group generation are not ordering inputs
ordinary replacement that is not a strict one_to_one-generation increase is rejected; SecurityAdvisory replacement is handled only by the equal-or-higher advisory rule

safety_freeze_resolution.applies_when: the parent is in a quarantine-induced SAFETY_FREEZE because active non-quarantined parent controllers are fewer than the parent majority
safety_freeze_resolution.restored_set: a non-empty subset of parent quarantined_control_devices; every restored controller must contribute its own freeze-challenge signature
safety_freeze_resolution.signer_universe: all parent controllers; quarantined controllers may sign only with the freeze-challenge capability
safety_freeze_resolution.postcondition: the child has at least the parent majority active and non-quarantined controllers

fork_resolution.rule: separate from safety-freeze resolution; device-only majority of the common ancestor and fork_ack covering every trusted observed branch; recovery forbidden

device_id_lifetime: permanently_revoked_devices is monotone; an ID in it can never re-enter active_control_devices or messaging_devices. Returning hardware/recovery uses a fresh DeviceID and fresh DeviceCredential.

minimum_crypto_profile_semantics.profile_requirement: referenced profile defines security_generation.one_to_one and is admissible for 1:1 use
minimum_crypto_profile_semantics.ordinary_raise: candidate security_generation.one_to_one is strictly greater than parent
minimum_crypto_profile_semantics.ordinary_equal_or_lower: forbidden/no raise; lower is always rejected
minimum_crypto_profile_semantics.group_generation: ignored by this ACS field; group floors are Room/group state
minimum_crypto_profile_semantics.security_advisory: may replace a forbidden profile only with a non-forbidden profile of equal or higher one_to_one generation
